services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repair
services.short_description: 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, with the parts already on the truck.
services.long_description: When you have a plumbing emergency, you can't afford to let the problem go from bad to worse. Bay Plumbing Co. has responded to Miami-Dade County plumbing emergencies 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year since 1968. Because we carry a large inventory of common plumbing materials on our own trucks, our plumbers arrive with what they need to fix most problems on the spot — no waiting on a supply house, no second appointment. We handle leaks of every kind, concealed or visible, on every type of pipe, and most can be repaired the same visit.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Stoppages
services.short_description: Video-located, jetted clear, and cleaned up before we leave.
services.long_description: It doesn't matter what's causing it or where it is — if your plumbing is stopped up, our Miami-Dade plumbers can get the water flowing freely again. We carry state-of-the-art video inspection equipment to find and reveal concealed damage inside your sewer lines rather than guessing, and jetting equipment to clear the line properly instead of just punching a hole through it. Where a line needs permanent access, we will dig down, locate it, and add a clean-out so the next service call takes minutes instead of hours.

services.title: Septic Systems & Drainfields
services.short_description: Inspected, pumped, repaired and replaced — with our own excavation equipment.
services.long_description: Even small septic problems caused by damage to the drainfield lead to big issues if they are not dealt with right away. Our septic professionals diagnose drainfield issues and perform the repairs or replacement needed. We handle inspections, repairs and pump-outs for septic tanks and grease traps, and we install complete septic systems and drainfields. Critically, we do not sub-contract septic work, excavation work or concrete removal — we own that equipment and run those crews in house, which is why the job gets finished on our schedule rather than somebody else's.

services.title: Backflow Testing & Certification
services.short_description: Certified testing, usually done in 15 to 20 minutes.
services.long_description: Annual backflow testing helps ensure that only clean, potable water flows through your plumbing into your home or business. Most Miami-Dade County businesses are required by County ordinance to have an up-to-date backflow preventer installed, and the Water and Sewer Department will often contact you directly to require a test. That is routine, not cause for alarm. Backflow Bob, Inc. — Bay Plumbing Co.'s certified backflow experts — is familiar with every type of preventer device, and in most cases can complete your test in 15 to 20 minutes with the equipment and materials on hand to handle simple repairs the same visit.

services.title: Water & Sewer Lines
services.short_description: Repaired, replaced, and connected to city sewer the right way the first time.
services.long_description: We repair or replace water and sewer lines depending on what the line actually needs, and we will tell you honestly which one you are looking at. Whether you are building a new home or finally connecting an older Miami property to the city sewer system, we make sure the connection is done right the first time so you don't have problems down the line. Because our own crews handle the excavation and the concrete removal, there is no waiting on a subcontractor between the dig and the repair.

faqs.a: Estimates are free for work more involved than a service call — remodeling, replacing water or sewer lines, replacing fixtures, and similar quoted work. A straightforward service call is billed as a service call. Ask us on the phone what your job counts as and we will tell you before we dispatch anyone.

Yes. We have had plumbers on call 24 hours a day, 365 days a year since 1968. Because our trucks carry a large inventory of common materials, an after-hours call usually gets fixed on the first visit rather than made safe and rebooked.

faqs.q: Do you sub-contract septic, excavation or concrete work?
faqs.a: No. We own the equipment and run the crews in house — septic tank work, excavation and concrete removal all included. That is why we can dig, repair and close up without waiting on another company's schedule.

faqs.q: How long does backflow testing take?
faqs.a: In most cases Backflow Bob, Inc. — our certified backflow testing arm — completes a test in 15 to 20 minutes, with the equipment and materials on hand to handle most simple repairs during the same visit.

faqs.q: Does Miami-Dade County require a backflow preventer?
faqs.a: Most Miami-Dade County businesses are required by County ordinance to have an up-to-date backflow preventer installed, and the Water and Sewer Department may contact you directly to require an annual test. Some older buildings never had one installed at all. If you are not sure what you have, call us and we will find out.

faqs.q: How long have you been in business?
faqs.a: Bay Plumbing Co. has been owned and operated by the same family since 1968 — 57 years serving Miami-Dade County from the same shop at 3029 SW 28th St.
Yes. Bay Plumbing Co. is licensed under C.C. 6469 and insured under CFC057007. Both numbers are printed on our trucks, our signage and our estimates.

faqs.q: Do you handle commercial as well as residential?
faqs.a: Both, plus industrial. We serve Miami-Dade's residential, commercial and industrial plumbing needs, and we work regularly with landlords and property managers running multiple units.
